guarantees.claim: When rst_ni is low, soc_dbg_policy_q.category is forced to DbgCategoryLocked, and soc_dbg_policy_q.valid and soc_dbg_policy_q.relocked are forced to MuBi4False.

formal.consequent: soc_dbg_policy_q.category == DbgCategoryLocked && soc_dbg_policy_q.valid == prim_mubi_pkg::MuBi4False && soc_dbg_policy_q.relocked == prim_mubi_pkg::MuBi4False

formal_sketch.consequent: soc_dbg_policy_q.category == DbgCategoryLocked && soc_dbg_policy_q.valid == prim_mubi_pkg::MuBi4False && soc_dbg_policy_q.relocked == prim_mubi_pkg::MuBi4False

guarantees.claim: On positive edge of clk_i when rst_ni is high, soc_dbg_policy_q updates to the value of soc_dbg_policy_d.

assumptions.claim: The producer of soc_dbg_policy_d must drive valid multi-bit values for 'valid' and 'relocked' fields (i.e., either MuBi4True or MuBi4False) at all times.
assumptions.risk: Invalid encoding could be stored and later misinterpreted as a valid debug policy state, bypassing security.

formal.consequent: soc_dbg_policy_d.valid inside {prim_mubi_pkg::MuBi4False, prim_mubi_pkg::MuBi4True} && soc_dbg_policy_d.relocked inside {prim_mubi_pkg::MuBi4False, prim_mubi_pkg::MuBi4True}

formal_sketch.consequent: soc_dbg_policy_d.valid inside {prim_mubi_pkg::MuBi4False, prim_mubi_pkg::MuBi4True} && soc_dbg_policy_d.relocked inside {prim_mubi_pkg::MuBi4False, prim_mubi_pkg::MuBi4True}

assumptions.claim: soc_dbg_policy_d.category must be a legal DbgCategory enum value.
assumptions.risk: Illegal category may cause undefined debug behavior or security policy violation.

uncertain_points.claim: The reset default sets category to DbgCategoryLocked; it must be confirmed that a locked default is compatible with all lifecycle states (e.g., test or debug-on-boot).
uncertain_points.risk: If the system expects debug access after certain resets, this default could prevent necessary operations, causing recovery failures.

formal_sketch.consequent: The reset default sets category to DbgCategoryLocked; it must be confirmed that a locked default is compatible with all lifecycle states (e.g., test or debug-on-boot)

uncertain_points.claim: No validation of incoming soc_dbg_policy_d.category before register storage; an illegal category could be stored silently.
uncertain_points.risk: An invalid category may later be used to make security-critical debug enable decisions, potentially allowing unauthorized access.

formal_sketch.consequent: No validation of incoming soc_dbg_policy_d.category before register storage; an illegal category could be stored silently

uncertain_points.claim: It is unclear whether the multi-bit integrity of valid and relocked fields is checked elsewhere in soc_dbg_ctrl; if not, a glitch could inject an invalid mubi encoding.
uncertain_points.risk: Storage of an invalid mubi value may bypass downstream integrity checks and allow an attacker to influence debug policy.

formal_sketch.consequent: It is unclear whether the multi-bit integrity of valid and relocked fields is checked elsewhere in soc_dbg_ctrl; if not, a glitch could inject an invalid mubi encoding

uncertain_points.claim: The purpose of the 'relocked' field is not defined locally; its functional role in security policy is unclear.
uncertain_points.risk: Misunderstanding relocked semantics could lead to incorrect integration of debug lockdown logic.

formal_sketch.consequent: The purpose of the 'relocked' field is not defined locally; its functional role in security policy is unclear
